tool.name: RFEM Mesh Generator (rfemcube)
tool.description: Generate structured hex mesh for RFEM analysis
tool.help:
Generates a structured hexahedral mesh for RFEM (Random Finite Element Method) analysis.
Uses the rfemcube tool to create a box of 8-node brick elements. The mesh and control file are passed to rfembc_thermal to add boundary conditions, then to rfemfield_thermal to assign spatially correlated random diffusivity values.
The .rf config is assembled from the input parameters. The variogram and correlation lengths control the spatial structure of the random field.
Total elements = nxe * nye * nze where nye = nels / nxe / nze.
